note: McNairy County publishes no queryable zoning district layer. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online for McNairy zoning and GIS returned nothing official. The county's GIS maps are static PDFs (county-map.html, selmer_tn_county_2017.pdf); Adamsville's zoning map is a PDF (cityofadamsville.com/pdfs/zoning_map.pdf); Selmer's zoning map is referenced in its Title 14 code but no online service was found. The only parcel layer found (HNTB TN County Parcel Map, McNairy_Parcels) has no zoning attribute, so it was not used.
